post.description: Authenticates a user using email and password, and returns a Sanctum personal access token to be used as a Bearer token on protected endpoints.
Revokes the current access token of the authenticated user.

get.description: Retrieves all gold price data. Requires the view-harga-emas permission.

post.description: Creates a new gold price record. Requires the create-harga-emas permission.

message.example: The nama produk field is required.

items.example: The nama produk field is required.

get.description: Retrieves a single gold price along with its latest 20 price history records. Requires the show-harga-emas permission.

put.description: Updates an existing gold price record. Requires the edit-harga-emas permission.

message.example: The harga beli field is required.

items.example: The harga beli field is required.

delete.description: Deletes a gold price record. Requires the delete-harga-emas permission.

get.description: Retrieves all purchase records. Requires the view-pembelians permission.

post.description: Creates a new purchase with its detail items and attaches it to a store. If the status is "completed", an outgoing transaction (type OUT) is automatically created. Requires the create-pembelians permission.

get.description: Retrieves a single purchase along with its related transaction (if the purchase has been completed). Requires the show-pembelians permission.

put.description: Updates an existing purchase and replaces all of its detail items. If the status changes from non-completed to "completed", an outgoing transaction (type OUT) is automatically created. Requires the edit-pembelians permission.

delete.description: Deletes a purchase record. Requires the delete-pembelians permission.

get.description: Retrieves all transactions belonging to a specific store. Requires the view-transaksis permission.

message.example: The toko id field is required.

items.example: The toko id field is required.

post.description: Creates a new transaction. Requires the create-transaksis permission.

get.description: Retrieves the current balance (saldo) of a specific store. Requires the view-transaksis permission.

message.example: The selected toko id is invalid.

items.example: The selected toko id is invalid.

get.description: Retrieves the total nominal of incoming transactions for a specific store. Requires the view-transaksis permission.

200.description: Total incoming transaction amount retrieved successfully

message.example: The selected toko id is invalid.

items.example: The selected toko id is invalid.

get.description: Retrieves the total nominal of outgoing transactions for a specific store. Requires the view-transaksis permission.

200.description: Total outgoing transaction amount retrieved successfully

message.example: The selected toko id is invalid.

items.example: The selected toko id is invalid.

get.description: Retrieves a single transaction by its ID. Requires the show-transaksis permission.

put.description: Updates an existing transaction. Requires the edit-transaksis permission.

delete.description: Deletes a transaction. Requires the delete-transaksis permission.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users along with their roles and permissions. Only accessible by users with the admin role.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role
